mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 4.7% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.7%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that weakens consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 110.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate capital expenditure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500.0 thousand units signal housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1500.0, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150,000 jobs per month supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 112.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 112.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment above 370,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 370000, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
